component.name: Mojac
component.summary: Bidirectional IPTV client with a full XMLTV guide

description.p: Mojac is an IPTV client for Android and Linux. It reads M3U/M3U8 playlists and XMLTV guides from one or more sources, including Tunarr and ErsatzTV, with optional support for self-signed HTTPS servers.

The guide is a zoomable timeline with per-channel schedules, now and next summaries, programme details, search and favourites. Arabic and English interfaces share first-class bidirectional text, and the Catppuccin themes include an AMOLED mode.
